name: Adeptus Astartes
note: Maximums from the table on p.25; Species Keywords from p.38.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter
abilities.text:
You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter.

Your Resolve increases by +1

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 19 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

name: Primaris Astartes
note: Maximums from the table on p.25; Species Keywords from p.38.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text:
You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter.

Your Resolve increases by +1.

As a Primaris, you ignore any impurities in your Chapter Gene-Seed, and also gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.
